name: Wireless Headphones
description: Premium noise-cancelling wireless headphones with 30hr battery life. Features deep bass, crystal-clear mids, and a comfortable over-ear design. Perfect for travel, work, and everyday listening.

name: Mechanical Keyboard
description: Mechanical RGB keyboard with hot-swappable switches and a magnetic wrist rest. Programmable macros, per-key lighting, and a durable aluminum frame. Built for serious gaming and productivity.

name: Smartphone
description: Flagship smartphone with a 6.7-inch AMOLED display and 120Hz refresh rate. Features a 108MP triple-camera system with optical zoom. All-day battery life and blazing-fast 5G connectivity.

name: Laptop Pro
description: Ultra-thin laptop with a stunning Retina display and M-series chip. 18-hour battery life keeps you going all day without a charger. Lightweight and powerful enough for video editing and coding.

name: Webcam HD 1080p
description: 1080p HD webcam with auto-focus and built-in noise-cancelling dual microphones. Low-light correction keeps you looking sharp in any environment. Plug-and-play USB setup with no drivers needed.

name: Trackball Mouse
description: Ergonomic trackball mouse with precision scrolling and wireless Bluetooth connectivity. Sculpted thumb rest reduces wrist strain during long work sessions. Works on any surface without a mousepad.
